title: Best Cornbread Ever
photoAlt: A round of golden cornbread in a cast-iron pan

equipment.note: Or a pie pan or tin.

equipment.item: Oven mitts or a thick towel

steps: **Mix** the wet and dry together, and add any extras.
**Grease** or oil the baking pan, and pour in the batter.

pace.text: All the mixing is done and the pan is oiled. This can sit for many hours; if overnight, cover and refrigerate.

steps: **Bake** 20–25 min at {temp:400F}. Use a handy spatula to get all the batter in the pan. Waste not.

photos.caption: All the mixing is done and the pan is oiled up. This can sit for many hours, but if overnight, cover and refrigerate.
Oven is at {temp:400F}. Pour the batter in and use a handy spatula to get all of it in there. Waste not.

steps: **Mix dry:** {qty:2 cups} cornmeal, {qty:2 tbsp} sugar (optional), {qty:1 tsp} each of salt, baking soda and baking powder.
**Whisk wet:** {qty:2} eggs, {qty:2 tbsp} EVOO, {qty:2 cups} buttermilk, {qty:2 tbsp} honey (optional).
**Mix** together. Add extras: jalapeños, cheese, cracklins.
**Pour** into an oiled 9–10 inch oven-safe pan.
keys: The batter can wait for hours (fridge overnight)
